lines.text: God created the heavens and the earth, spoke light into being, and called the darkness night.
On the second day God made an expanse between the waters and called it valley.
On the fourth day God made the greater light to rule the day and the lesser light to rule the night.
God made man in His image, blessed them, and told them to fill the seas and rule over creatures.
On the seventh day God rested from all His work, blessed that day, and sanctified it.
